remarks: Welcome to this charming 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home located on a peaceful cul-de-sac, within minutes to everything. This home offers spacious living space on the first floor, perfect for both relaxing and entertaining, and 4 large bedrooms on the second floor, including an airy primary suite, with vaulted ceilings. Enjoy the outdoors and ample front yard from the deck off of the living room or from the rear terrace off of the family room which offers additional space for an office, playroom, den or more. Enjoy this wonderful home and the convenience of being just minutes from top-rated schools, train, dining and shopping, including the new retail offerings at the Darien Commons. A great place to call home!
